title: Jack-o'-lantern with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='pumpkinGrad' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF8C00'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#E07000'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C05500'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='stemGrad' cx='50%' cy='30%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#6B8E23'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3E5A0A'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='46' y='12' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='url(#stemGrad)'/>
  <rect x='49' y='10' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#7BA428'/>
  <!-- pumpkin body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='38' ry='32' fill='url(#pumpkinGrad)'/>
  <!-- pumpkin ridges in lighter orange -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='24' ry='32' fill='none' stroke='#FFAA33' stroke-width='2.5' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='12' ry='31' fill='none' stroke='#FFAA33' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- left eye -->
  <polygon points='32,46 40,42 40,54' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='32,46 40,42 40,54' fill='#FFEE88' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <polygon points='68,46 60,42 60,54' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <polygon points='68,46 60,42 60,54' fill='#FFEE88' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <polygon points='50,54 46,60 54,60' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M34,66 Q38,74 42,70 Q46,76 50,70 Q54,76 58,70 Q62,74 66,66' 
        fill='none' stroke='#FFD700' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <rect x='41' y='66' width='4' height='5' rx='1' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <rect x='49' y='66' width='4' height='5' rx='1' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <rect x='57' y='66' width='4' height='5' rx='1' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='60' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FF6633' opacity='0.4'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='60' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FF6633' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- highlight on pumpkin top -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='36' rx='12' ry='5' fill='#FFBB55' opacity='0.35'/>
</svg>
